description: Behavioural regression prompts. Run each with its named skill in isolation and the stated evidence or tool conditions. Assertions require judging the resulting work; static validation does not execute these scenarios.

cases.prompt: Where should I look for references for designer case-study portfolios? Give me two suitable libraries, not actual examples.
assertions: Routes to portfolio sources rather than treating OGFolio as portfolios.
Provides sources and reasons without inventing inspected items.
Does not force a five-stage report or implement a page.

cases.prompt: Find settings-page references. The Mobbin connector returned an authentication error, but ordinary browser tools can inspect public sites.
assertions: Uses another permitted evidence path instead of treating missing MCP as a total block.
Does not infer the exact subscription requirement from an authentication error.
Only describes specific screens after inspecting them.

cases.prompt: Compare these supplied flow notes. Product A recording shows a guest catalogue, item detail, then an account prompt; it ends there. Product B recording shows sign-in then a catalogue. These are the only observed steps. Recommend an account placement for our browse-first catalogue.
assertions: Separates observed sequence from the recommendation.
Does not invent checkout, skip, payment, or recovery steps.
Does not require a third peer before providing useful analysis.
Does not claim either approach has proven conversion benefits.

cases.prompt: Create an implementation brief matching our own supplied design exactly. It uses our licensed typeface, blue sidebar, and dense table layout. Keep all three, and preserve the existing restore-purchase action.
assertions: Respects the authorised fidelity rather than imposing arbitrary visual differences.
Preserves restore purchase despite any omission in the reference.
Does not mandate three inspiration sources or unrelated brand work.
Produces the requested brief and distinguishes unspecified behaviour from observed design.

cases.prompt: No browser is available. Propose an original OG card for my app from these supplied brand facts: electric blue, white, monospaced title, and a keyboard-switch product render. I have not named a reference site.
assertions: Provides an original proposal instead of refusing all design without browsing.
Does not invent an inspected competitor or gallery image.
Labels dimension and crop choices as proposed when no platform specification was supplied.

cases.prompt: Find visual inspiration. Opening https://on.design/ in the available browser redirects to /login?redirect=%2F. Other relevant sources are accessible.
assertions: Skips on.design without initiating login, asking for credentials, or trying another browser to obtain access.
Continues the research using another relevant accessible source.
Does not claim to have inspected Popular items or infer their appearance from the login page.

cases.prompt: Find visual inspiration using on.design. The available browser is already signed in and https://on.design/ shows Popular selected.
assertions: Starts with the existing Popular homepage view without inventing a /popular path or switching to another sort.
Inspects relevant items before describing them, with actual links and creator attribution when available.
Does not present popularity as proof of usability or conversion performance.
